subject: Renewal: consolidate invoicing to US parent + APAC capacity add — temporary Net30 for first invoice
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumixsys.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts@lumixsys.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: request to bill US parent + APAC capacity add (PO attached)

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing to sign the renewal for the account and would like to consolidate invoicing to our US parent (Lumix Holdings, EIN: 12-3456789) for the upcoming 12-month commitment. Our procurement team attached the PO (Lumix_PO_99877.pdf).

Two quick asks before we finalize:
- Can Redwood issue the invoice to Lumix Holdings (US) while we add +120k token capacity in APAC (we have an APAC entity but prefer centralized billing)?
- For the first renewal invoice only, can we take Net30 instead of our standard Net45 to align with an internal month-end close? We expect subsequent invoices to be Net45.

I've attached an entity list for APAC and the draft PO. Let me know what evidence you need (W-8/W-9 or EU VAT) and if the temporary Net30 is doable.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Cloud Ops, Lumix Systems
jordan.lee@lumixsys.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Lumix_PO_99877.pdf, Lumix_APAC_entity_list.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumixsys.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: request to bill US parent + APAC capacity add (PO attached)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the PO and the APAC roster. Looping in Priya (billing lead) and Ben (account owner) to confirm routing and the temporary terms.

High level items we'll validate:
1) Confirm Lumix Holdings (US) as the payee on invoices — we'll need the legal payee name exactly as it should appear and the EIN you provided.
2) APAC capacity: we can provision the +120k tokens in SG region and tag usage to the APAC entity for telemetry; billing can still be consolidated to the US parent.
3) Temporary Net30 request: need approvals from finance; will confirm if this can be applied to invoice #1 of the renewal only.
4) Tax forms: for the US payee we'll require a completed W-9 from Lumix Holdings; for any APAC entity movement we may ask for local VAT IDs if passthrough is required.

I expect Priya will follow up with a short checklist and an updated invoice template.

Best,
Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Lumix payor consolidation + Net30 ask — docs checklist

Kim / Ben — I pulled the billing checklist and finance policy. Quick notes before I reply to Lumix: 

- Documents needed from Lumix to bill US parent: signed PO, completed W-9 for Lumix Holdings (we already have EIN from Jordan but need the IRS form), and confirmation of legal payee address.
- APAC entity list is fine; if Lumix wants us to show a detailed breakdown by entity for usage reporting we can add a split-line in the invoice PDF, but only the US parent will be the payor.
- Temporary Net30: finance prefers to avoid exceptions but will approve a one-off Net30 if Lumix signs the renewal and uses the attached DocuSign SOW. I'll request that approval now (attaching SOW stub).
- PO number mapping: we'll map Lumix_PO_99877 to Redwood contract RED-99877 so ledger reconciliation is straightforward.

I'll draft the 'invoice instructions' email and include a W-9 template link. Ben — do you want me to mirror the usage breakdown by APAC entity on the invoice or ship a separate usage report monthly?

Attachments: Redwood_Statement-of-Work-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Priya
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Lumix payor consolidation + Net30 ask — docs checklist

Priya — please include the APAC breakdown as a separate appendix CSV each month (one line per entity) rather than line items on the invoice. Lumix likes a clean single-payee invoice for AR.

Also: approve the one-off Net30 contingent on DocuSign SOW signed by Lumix and receipt of W-9 by the time we generate the first invoice. If finance flags anything I can escalate.

Let's get the W-9 and DocuSign link to Jordan today so procurement can route quickly.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumixsys.com>, Accounts Payable <accounts@lumixsys.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Action items: W-9, DocuSign SOW, PO mapping for Lumix renewal

Jordan — thanks for the quick turn. To confirm next steps from Redwood: 

1) Please return a completed W-9 for Lumix Holdings (PDF) and confirm the exact invoicing address to print on the invoice.
2) We will send the DocuSign SOW (Redwood_Statement-of-Work-v2.pdf) for signature — signing that will be the trigger for the one-off Net30 on invoice #1.
3) We'll map PO Lumix_PO_99877 to our contract ID RED-99877 and include an APAC usage appendix (CSV) each month. The invoice itself will be billed to Lumix Holdings, US.

Attached is the DocuSign link and the W-9 template. Once we receive the W-9 and signed SOW we'll queue the renewal and provision the +120k APAC capacity (targeting 2026-12-15 provisioning).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/results/CBJCHBCAABAAz-999example
W-9 template: https://drive.company/W9-template.pdf

Best,
Kim
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumixsys.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts@lumixsys.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action items: W-9, DocuSign SOW, PO mapping for Lumix renewal

Hi Kim / Priya — thanks. Attached is the signed W-9 for Lumix Holdings and we've completed the DocuSign SOW (signed by procurement). PO Lumix_PO_99877 remains the reference.

We agree to the monthly APAC appendix CSV for usage. The team will expect invoice #1 on 2026-12-20 (Net30) and then standard Net45 thereafter. Please confirm when the first invoice is issued and that the APAC capacity provisioning is scheduled for 2026-12-15.

Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Cloud Ops, Lumix Systems

Attachments: Lumix_W9_signed.pdf, DocuSign_SOW_signed.pdf
